Put each row in the report it belongs to

report_assemble.Rd

A row belongs to its owner, as the log says, and not to requested_by, which an import writes as it likes: the creator, or the referent the round has since passed the row to by writing owned_by (log_owner()). The column is still called creator, from before rows could pass. The owner is the one standing at the end of the month covered, which provisioning_report() settles before it gets here. The report goes to the same person the round asks to approve a change. A person asked for by two referents is in both reports, each with their own rows.

Usage

report_assemble(
  rows,
  directory,
  period,
  previous = list(),
  unread = character()
)

Arguments

rows

What report_rows() answered.

directory

A directory frame, as directory_users() returns it.

period

What report_month() answered.

previous

The entries of the earlier months' ledgers, as report_ledger_previous() reads them.

unread

The earlier months whose ledger did not read. A person who could have been in one of their reports gets storia_nota false, and the mail says nothing about earlier reports rather than something false.

Value

A list with referenti, one report per referent named after them, each a list of referente, attivati (rows), senza_primo_accesso (people) and non_giudicati (a count); it, NULL when there is nothing for IT, otherwise a list of senza_referente (rows, with motivo), non_giudicabili (people, with referente and motivo) and senza_data (rows); and senza_creatore, how many rows have no referent to go to. Since rows can pass, that means without an established owner and not only without a creator; the name stays, because it is a column of UbepRapporto_CL, and a renamed column would keep the table's history under one name and the new records under another.

Details

Three items, of which phase 1 fills two:

  • activated in the month, one line per request, new or modified. It is information, and does not count among the things to look at. A new one says whether its account was new: account is nuovo when Entra made the account no earlier than the minute the row was made (creata_il), esistente when earlier, "" when either date is missing;

  • no first sign-in, one item per person, with every project of theirs: the requests of that person activated at least report_grace_days() before the reading and not expired, when Entra says nobody has entered the account (report_first_access()). The thirty days run from the later of two dates, in Italian time: the channel's first execution for the username the row names now (report_person_since()), and the birth of that account on Entra. A username corrected by a modification, or an account made again, is not dated by an activation that was somebody else's. The item carries the earliest of those dates among the person's requests, how many days and months of thirty days ago it was, and the dates of the earlier reports of the same referent that named the person;

  • no access for more than a year is phase 2, and the mail says it was not checked.

What has no referent to go to goes to IT, and to nobody else: a row whose owner the log does not establish (no creation names it, or the log cannot say whom it belongs to, log_owner()), or whose owner Entra holds disabled, or does not hold, or cannot say; a person whose account is disabled, missing, without a creation date or that cannot otherwise be judged; a row the log does not date. A disabled owner receives nothing.

A referent whose people went to IT without being judged is told how many, in the report itself: the principle of the all-clear, which must not cover an item nobody measured. non_giudicati counts them, a person once: the people of that referent the report could not judge, and those of the rows the log does not date.
